name: Malaysian Cube Championship 2017
information: Malaysian Cube Championship 2017 is opened to all nationalities, but only Malaysians are eligible to win the prizes. **Registration info** * Registration opens on Tuesday, 7th November, 8pm (GMT+8). * The steps for registration are as follows: 1. [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysianCubeChampionship2017/register) 2. [Pay](https://www.mycubeassociation.com/payment-malaysiancubechamp) according the the events you registered. 3. Once we have confirmed correct payment, we will accept your registration. **In order to complete your registration please proceed with the payment according to the events registered. Payment which does not match with the event registered will not be accepted and the payment will be refund.
